title: Creature Features
desc: Animal absurdity, plant cunning & ocean strangeness

questions.q: A group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'. What's a group of pugs called?
Sharks are older than trees — by how much?
questions.a: About 100 million years (sharks: ~450M years, trees: ~350M years)

questions.q: Which animal's heart stops beating when it dives underwater, then restarts when it surfaces?
questions.a: Marine iguanas — their heart rate drops to near zero during deep dives

questions.q: Bamboo holds the record for fastest-growing plant. How fast can some species grow per day?
questions.a: Up to 91 cm (about 3 feet) in a single day

questions.q: What colour is an octopus's blood, and why?
questions.a: Blue — it uses copper-based haemocyanin instead of iron-based haemoglobin

questions.q: Sea otters hold hands while sleeping. What's the actual reason?
questions.a: To avoid drifting apart — it's called 'rafting'

questions.q: The pistol shrimp creates a sound louder than a gunshot. How does it do it?
questions.a: By snapping its claw shut so fast it creates a cavitation bubble that produces a shockwave of 218+ decibels

questions.q: Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated — true or false?
questions.a: True — studies show measurably lower cortisol levels when they're with their preferred companion

questions.q: The largest living organism on Earth isn't a whale — it's a what?
questions.a: A honey fungus (Armillaria ostoyae) in Oregon — it covers 2,385 acres underground
Grey or white — they turn pink from their diet of brine shrimp and algae containing carotenoid pigments
